items.name: swift-atlas
items.description: SwiftAtlas is an intelligent code analysis and visualization toolkit for Swift projects. It maps class dependencies, relationships, and usage across your codebase — helping you understand architecture, detect design smells, and improve maintainability.

items.name: enews
items.description: Enews app utilizes the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architecture to ensure a clean separation of concerns and improve the maintainability and testability of the codebase.

items.name: CodeAtlas
items.description: CodeAtlas is an AI-powered software intelligence platform that helps developers understand complex codebases by analyzing repository structure, dependencies, and architecture. It uses LLMs and RAG techniques to generate clear, contextual insights that improve code comprehension and developer productivity.

items.name: SDA-Assignment-SOLID-Principles
items.description: Refactoring a messy Java codebase by applying SOLID principles (SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP) to improve scalability, maintainability, and clean architecture. Includes before and after implementation.

items.name: GeeksForGeeks
items.description: A new Next.js-based website (2026 codebase) for the official GeeksforGeeks SRMIST Delhi NCR chapter. Built from scratch with improved performance, modern UI, and scalable architecture.

items.name: proj_1--github_archi
items.description: Codebase Doctor is an AI-powered web application that analyzes GitHub repositories and helps developers understand, diagnose, and improve their codebases.  Users provide a repository, and the system analyzes its structure, dependencies, architecture, code quality, security, and potential issues.

items.name: CODE-REFACTORING-AND-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION
items.description: Core refactoring phase for performance and code quality. Optimized an existing codebase to enhance readability, boost network efficiency, and improve overall system responsiveness. Focus on best practices and maintainable architecture.

items.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
items.description: The Tic Tac Toe game is designed using a Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) architecture, which separates the application into distinct components, promoting a clean and maintainable codebase. This architecture allows for better organization of code, easier testing, and improved scalability

items.name: self-improving-agent
items.description: A universal self-improving agent that learns from ALL skill experiences. Uses multi-memory architecture (semantic + episodic + working) to continuously evolve the codebase. Auto-triggers on skill completion/error with hooks-based self-correction.

items.name: cognitia
items.description: Cognitia is a work-in-progress public version of my earlier project, project-mimental. It builds on the original codebase and is currently undergoing active development to improve code quality, architecture, and additional features over time.

items.name: high-agent-graph-tui
items.description: High-Agent Graph_x_0x0 Agent TUI: Mathematical codebase analysis engine with ratatui dashboard, regime switching, deviation detection, Python mirror, and self-improving loops. Integrates with Hermes AI agent ecosystem for local code intelligence and architecture governance.

items.name: CodeLens-AI
items.description: CodeLens-AI is an AI-powered tool that makes complex codebases easy to understand. It analyzes repositories to explain project purpose, folder structures, architecture, dependencies, and file logic, helping developers onboard faster, spot issues, and improve code quality.

items.name: nexbank-architecture-refactor
items.description: Modernized a university coursework Java Swing banking system by refactoring a monolithic codebase into a layered MVC-Service-DAO architecture. Implemented SOLID principles, dependency injection, secure PBKDF2 password hashing, and externalized configuration management to improve maintainability, security, and scalability.

items.name: Snake-game
items.description: A fully functional Snake game built using Python and Pygame, with a structured and modularized codebase. This project is a work in progress, as I continuously improve it by enhancing graphics, refining the architecture, and adding more in-depth documentation.

items.name: CodeSense-AI
items.description: CodeSense AI analyzes codebases to generate code explanations, API docs, READMEs, UML diagrams, architecture diagrams, dependency graphs, and RAG-based repository Q&A. Built with Java Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and IBM Granite-compatible LLMs to improve productivity, onboarding, and maintainability.

items.name: Bike-Shop
items.description: This project was part of my learning journey to improve my Flutter development skills. I built the entire app from a Figma design, implemented Riverpod for state management, and structured the codebase using Clean Architecture to keep everything scalable and maintainable.
